Name: Phantom Guard - Summon Combat Companion
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Phantom Guard
[/b][/size]
[i]Never explore the mines alone again.
[/i][/center][i][center][size=3]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url][/size][/center]


[size=3][color=#ffff00]👻The Phantom skin is from this Mod:[/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40350]Radical Raiders - a Monster Redesign and Variant Mod👻[/url]
[/size][/i]
Phantom Guard allows you to channel your energy to summon a loyal, customizable Ghost ally. This isn't just a passive pet; it is a fully combat-capable bodyguard with smart AI that detects enemies across the map, protects you, and ensures you get all the loot and XP.


[center]﻿[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZ3M5MXZkdW9iYnl5bmc2dzFjbDF2anl4ZXZuOGF6M3huN3c1bjVyNyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/VwYbwfv7S5EvFWXyPI/giphy.gif[/img]﻿[/center]
[size=4][b]Features
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Smart Combat AI:[/b] The Phantom doesn't wait for enemies to get close. It scans the entire map, flies directly to targets at high speed, and engages them automatically.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Full Loot & XP Credit:[/b] Unlike other summon mods, when the Phantom kills a monster, [b]you[/b] get the XP, the loot drops, and credit for the Adventurer's Guild Monster Slayer goals.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Area Defense:[/b] The Phantom fights for you in the current location. It vanishes automatically when you leave the map (go down a ladder or warp) or when its duration expires.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Bodyguard Behavior:[/b] When no enemies are present, the Phantom hovers faithfully behind you.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Balanced Gameplay:[/b] Summoning requires Energy (Stamina), making it a tactical choice rather than a cheat.
[/list]
[center][youtube]J3NJEZGo2T0[/youtube]﻿[/center][size=4][b]Configuration (GMCM)
[/b][/size]
This mod is fully compatible with [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]. You can tweak almost every aspect of your ally to balance the game to your liking:

[list]
[*][b]Ghost Stats:[/b] Customize Max HP, Attack Damage, and Attack Speed.
[*][b]Tankiness:[/b] Adjust a "Damage Taken Multiplier" to make your ghost fragile or nearly invincible.
[*][b]Duration:[/b] Set how long the summon lasts (Default: 90 seconds / ~2 in-game hours).
[*][b]Cost:[/b] Adjust the Energy cost to summon.
[*][b]Controls:[/b] Rebind the summon key (Default: 'V').
[/list]
[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41382/41382-1768708312-430798767.png[/img]﻿[/center][size=4][b]How to Use
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have enough Energy.
[*]Press [b]V[/b] (configurable).
[*]A Phantom will appear behind you.
[*]It will immediately hunt down any monsters in the current area.
[*]The Phantom will vanish if you leave the map. You can simply summon a fresh one in the new area!
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41382/41382-1768708312-1524262605.png[/img]﻿[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
[*](Optional but Recommended) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game settings.
[*]Unzip the [b]PhantomGuard[/b] folder into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
